_comment: Procurement Fraud Investigator — Mission-Critical Test Blueprint
name: Procurement Fraud Investigator
description: Exercises every advanced node type: Webhook trigger, Parallel Fork (OCR+LLM & SQL vendor lookup), LLM Router for risk scoring, Human Approval checklist, and final Output report. Used for Golden Run regression testing.

invoice_pdf_url.description: Publicly accessible URL to the PDF

data.description: Fires when a new invoice PDF arrives via the procurement webhook.
Simultaneously extract line items from the PDF and check vendor in DB.

data.system_prompt: You are a document analysis expert. Extract structured data from invoice text. Return JSON only.
data.user_prompt:
Extract the following from this invoice:
- vendor_name
- invoice_date
- line_items (list of {description, quantity, unit_price, total})
- total_amount
- currency

Invoice URL: {{ state.invoice_pdf_url }}
Invoice ID: {{ state.invoice_id }}

data.description: Check if the vendor exists in the approved vendor registry.

input_mapping.expression: SELECT id, name, status, approved_since, risk_tier FROM vendors WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER('%{{ state.extracted_invoice.vendor_name }}%') LIMIT 1

routes.name: high_risk
routes.description: Amount > $10,000 or vendor is new/unregistered or high-risk tier

routes.name: standard
routes.description: Known vendor, amount within normal range

data.system_prompt: You are an automated procurement approval system.
You are a compliance reporting assistant. Generate a professional procurement decision report.

data.description: Final procurement approval/denial report stored for audit trail.

dimensions.name: extraction_accuracy
dimensions.description: Did the OCR+LLM correctly extract all invoice fields?

dimensions.name: routing_correctness
dimensions.description: Was the risk tier correctly assigned?

dimensions.name: report_quality
dimensions.description: Is the final report professional and complete?

dimensions.name: latency_sla
dimensions.description: Did the workflow complete within 90 seconds?
